services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: If you’re an avid saltwater angler, you’re probably familiar with Naples fishing. If you’ve never experienced it for yourself, you’ve probably heard about how great the fishing grounds are around Southwest Florida. While most fishermen come to test their skills against tarpon, snook, or king mackerel, another fish’s abundant in the Naples waters, and it’s just as much fun to catch. I am talking about Naples shark fishing! Naples shark fishing is some of the best in Florida. Local species include lemon sharks, blacktip sharks, Atlantic sharp-nose sharks, hammerheads, nurse sharks, spinners, and tough bull sharks.
